boxers_name_len.name: boxers_name_len
boxers_name_len.value: char_length("boxers"."first_name") between 1 and 60 and char_length("boxers"."last_name") between 1 and 60

conversations_kind_links.name: conversations_kind_links
conversations_kind_links.value:
("conversations"."kind" = 'general' and "conversations"."boxer_id" is null and "conversations"."proposal_id" is null)
        or ("conversations"."kind" = 'boxer' and "conversations"."boxer_id" is not null and "conversations"."proposal_id" is null)
        or ("conversations"."kind" = 'proposal' and "conversations"."proposal_id" is not null and "conversations"."boxer_id" is null)

directory_clubs_verified_consistent.name: directory_clubs_verified_consistent
directory_clubs_verified_consistent.value: ("directory_clubs"."address_status" = 'verified') = ("directory_clubs"."address_verified_at" is not null and "directory_clubs"."address" is not null)
